Warren Buffett reportedly hasn't consumed water in decades

Billionaire investor Bill Ackman stated that Warren Buffett has not consumed water for approximately 48 to 50 years, opting for Cherry Coke instead. Buffett is known for his daily consumption of five cans of Coke and has publicly joked about his preference for the beverage.
